diff_source: gh pr diff 631 -> diff.patch (563 lines, 10 files, +359/-14)

rejected_detail.title: Unresolved application notification click is a silent no-op
rejected_detail.reason: Graceful no-op on unresolved live clicks is the explicitly user-approved design per the reviewer briefing lens-guard ('else graceful no-op'); re-litigating it is out of scope.

rejected_detail.title: Real-arm resolver only consults the on-screen vacancy's leaderboard
rejected_detail.reason: The client-side resolution choice (loaded leaderboard, else no-op) is user-approved per the briefing 'What NOT to re-litigate'.

reviewer_agreement: No navigation (click -> route) pin for vacancy-typed notifications

local_verification.tailwind_built_css: pb-28, overflow-x-auto, shrink-0, min-h-[44px] all present

findings.title: Stale leaderboard resolves a fabricated vacancy id on non-detail routes (VacancyEdit/Comparison/deep-linked ApplicationDetail never reset leaderboard)
findings.detail: get_vacancy_id returns Some(id) for VacancyEdit/Comparison/ApplicationDetail, but handle_browser_change resets leaderboard to Loading only on VacancyDetail/VacancyHandoff entry. A stale Success(A) leaderboard survives onto a route for vacancy B (deep link or back-nav), and an application-notification click for an A-application resolves Some(B) — the exact fabricated-vacancy-id failure the resolver's own doc comment claims to avoid. Real application-typed notifications exist (server/src/ai/ai_notifications.gleam:56).
findings.recommended_fix: Tag the leaderboard with the vacancy id it was fetched for (leaderboard_vacancy_id set on AppRequestedLeaderboard/ApiReturnedLeaderboard) and require equality with the route vid in resolve_application_vacancy; or reset leaderboard on VacancyEdit/Comparison/ApplicationDetail entry too.

findings.title: No navigation (click -> route) pin for vacancy-typed notifications; vacancy test asserts only dropdown close (advisory test gate: FAIL)
findings.detail: Reviewer briefing hard-blocker class and spec AC both require a navigation test (click -> route) for BOTH entity types. Application side pins the routing decision via resolve_application_vacancy tests; vacancy side asserts only show_notification_dropdown == False despite 'navigating' in the test name. No other test or bug-hunt scenario pins vacancy notification click -> /vacancies/<vid>.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract the vacancy path construction into a pure helper (mirroring resolve_application_vacancy) and pin it, so both entity types have a routing-decision test.

findings.title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding added but untested; only application_detail padding is pinned
findings.detail: Lens-guard fix 1 requires pb-28 on BOTH pages; client/test pins pb-28 only for application_detail (client_test.gleam:5022-5043). A revert on vacancy_detail would go uncaught.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 present when comparison_ids non-empty and absent when empty, mirroring application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test.

findings.title: Filter pill shrink-0 change (fix 3, chip truncation root-cause) has no test
findings.detail: Fix 3 changed the leaderboard filter pill class so the rail scrolls instead of clipping labels mid-word. The only shrink-0 pin in client/test is the stepper test (client_test.gleam:5009-5013); no test covers the filter pill.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a leaderboard_view render test asserting the filter pills carry shrink-0.

findings.title: Demo arm still never navigates vacancy-typed notifications while the real arm does; comment overclaims parity
findings.evidence: UserClickedNotification(id, entity_type, entity_id) -> ... Some("application"), Some(aid) -> ... | _, _ -> effect.none()
findings.detail: The demo arm gains application navigation but vacancy clicks remain mark-read-only (pre-existing gap, unchanged by this diff); the hunk comment claims 'the same behaviour the real arm now has', which is only true for application.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a Some("vacancy"), Some(vid) -> modem.push("/vacancies/" <> vid, ...) branch to the demo arm, or narrow the parity comment.

findings.title: Rejected/auto-closed stepper rails lack md:justify-end that the pipeline rail gained
findings.evidence: "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible md:justify-end" (pipeline) vs "...md:overflow-visible" (rejected/auto-closed)
findings.detail: All three rails previously shared identical classes; the pipeline rail now right-aligns on desktop while its siblings don't, with no stated reason.
findings.recommended_fix: Add md:justify-end to view_rejected and view_auto_closed containers, or comment the intentional difference.

findings.title: demo_flow_test binds notifications then discards it with let _
findings.evidence: let #(notifications, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store) | unread |> should.equal(1) | ... | let _ = notifications
findings.detail: The test never asserts the read row (is_read == True for n-1); the stated 'marks the row read' contract is only pinned via the unread count.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert notifications contains n-1 with is_read == True, or destructure as #(_, unread).

findings.title: Deep-link navigation logic duplicated between real arm and demo arm
findings.evidence: Some("application"), Some(aid) -> case demo_store.find_vacancy_id_for_application(store, aid) { Some(vid) -> modem.push("/vacancies/" <> vid <> "/applications/" <> aid, ...
findings.detail: demo_update re-implements the entity match, vacancy lookup, and route-string construction from client.gleam; two copies of the route contract can drift. Direct reuse would be a circular import.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the deep-link decision/route builder into a neutral helper module both arms import.
